title: Jagorar Shuka Gero a Lokacin Damina

headings.text: Jagorar Shuka Gero a Lokacin Damina

key_sentences: Gero shi ne babban abincin mutane da dama a yankinmu, kuma yana jure fari fiye da sauran hatsi.
Wannan takarda tana bayyana matakan da manomi zai bi domin samun amfanin gona mai yawa.
Ku zaɓi ingantaccen iri wanda yake girma cikin kwanaki 75 zuwa 90.
Iri mai kyau yana da tsabta, ba shi da ƙwari, kuma yana tsiro da sauri.
Domin ƙarin bayani, ku tuntuɓi jami'in wayar da kan manoma na ƙaramar hukumarku.
Ana rarraba wannan takarda kyauta ga manoma.

rows: Share ciyawa kuma a zuba taki na gargajiya
Bayan ruwan sama na farko mai kyau (akalla mm 20)
A bar shuke-shuke uku a kowane rami
Gram 2 na takin NPK a kowane rami
Kafin gero ya fara yin kai
Lokacin da kawunan gero suka bushe kuma ƙwayoyin suka yi tauri

list_items.text: 1. Kada ku shuka kafin ƙasa ta jiƙe sosai.
2. Ku yi amfani da hanyar zai domin tara ruwa da taki a cikin rami.
3. Ku haɗa gero da wake domin ƙara wa ƙasa ƙarfi.
4. Ku adana iri a wuri mai bushe, nesa da ɓeraye.

notes: Hausa agricultural extension leaflet, one page. Hausa hooked letters ɓ ɗ ƙ as written; the apostrophe in "jami'in" is an ASCII apostrophe. The work calendar table has some cells of two lines (joined with one space). Typed numbered list "1." to "4.". Letterhead and footer are furniture. The coloured side note at the right of the closing paragraph block is body text and is read after the main column.
